user_raid_experience_20260925.reliability: authoritative_plan_per_coordinator; native data conflicts recorded under conflicts
claims: Atramedes has a very large hitbox; melee stay at max melee range to have room to dodge the Sonar Pulse rings.
One ranged on bell duty, usually a hunter (mobile): the gongs on Searing Flame and in the air phase.
In the air phase up to 3 players on gongs: the hunter, maybe the mage, and another very fast player (druid in cat form with Dash or Stampeding Roar, shaman with Ghost Wolf, rogue with Sprint).

Mage: after the first acquire-target, wait until the targeted player can no longer outrun it, click; when the flame reaches the mage, Ice Block and wait the full duration in place; on exit Blink (and Nitro Boots with engineering); by then the acquire target is usually done; once per fight (Ice Block cooldown).
Without a mage: kite as long as possible, then gong.
Players with mobility spells are better at air gongs because they outrun the laser longer; maybe 2 gongs per air phase, not 3.

Replay of successive air phases, each after a strategy-gonged ground Searing Flame (flame spawn 7 s and 3 s after liftoff, stack cap 10 and 99): phase 1 (9 shields, 100%) and phase 2 (phase-1 leftovers less one, 60%) first catch at once, later catches within 0.25 s, 2-4 strikes; phase 3 with three shields left (25%: the farthest three for every target and all 120 three-shield sets) first catch within 1.5 s and 3 ticks. User raid experience (2026-09-25, authoritative): melee hold slots at maximum melee range (21.58 yd, melee range 22.83 from CombatReach 20) behind the boss and dodge Sonar Pulse around the boss at that distance; the hunter owns the gongs; the air gong team is the hunter, the mage and the most mobile other player (by capability; balance druid, then rogue); the chased player spends its mobility (Sprint, Dash, Stampeding Roar from 4 s before contact; Blink, Disengage at contact; Aspect of the Cheetah left out: it fights the persistent Aspect of the Hawk) before anyone strikes; the mage with Ice Block ready takes the rescue strike, holds still (still casting), blocks when the flame is within 8 yd, waits the block and blinks out; a chased mage blocks by itself; readiness only from published cooldowns including the GCD (player MechanicTimers), never assumed. Replay: at most 2 shields per 31 s air phase in every run with the native 7 s spawn (54 of 58 with the 3 s stress spawn).
